Aliamini dola kubwa ilikuwa imeamua kuua imani kwa nguvu za kijeshi. Ndipo akajisemea kwa sauti ya ndani: “Kama wao wana nguvu za silaha, basi sisi tuna nguvu ya imani.” Hapo ndipo akaamua kuingia vitani dhidi ya Urusi, na baadaye akaigeukia Marekani.

Osama bin Mohammed bin Awad bin Laden alizaliwa tarehe 10 Machi 1957 huko Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, katika familia iliyokuwa na utajiri mkubwa kupita maelezo. Baba yake alikuwa bilionea wa ujenzi, akijenga barabara, majumba na misikiti kwa serikali. Osama alikulia katika neema ambazo wengi hawazifahamu, lakini moyo wake haukukaa kwenye anasa. Alivutiwa zaidi na masomo ya dini, simulizi za mapambano, na wazo la kujitoa kwa kile alichokiamini.

Alipoitikia kilio cha Afghanistan, aliacha starehe, akaondoka Saudi Arabia, akapitia Pakistan, kisha akaingia kwenye milima na mapango. Alienda na fedha nyingi, akafadhili wapiganaji, akajenga kambi, barabara na njia za msaada. Alipotoka vitani akiwa hai, Urusi ikiwa imesalimu amri, jina lake likaanza kutajwa kwa sauti ya heshima miongoni mwa waliompiga Urusi.

Baada ya Warusi kuondoka Afghanistan, Osama alitarajia kuona nchi za Kiislamu zikiwa huru na zisizo chini ya nguvu za mataifa ya kigeni. Lakini matumaini hayo hayakudumu kwa muda mrefu. Mwaka 1990, wakati wa Vita vya Ghuba, wanajeshi wa Marekani waliingia Saudi Arabia, jambo lililomchoma sana moyoni. Kwa mtazamo wake, hili halikuwa tukio la kawaida la kijeshi, bali lilikuwa ni fedheha kubwa kwa ulimwengu wa Kiislamu. Aliona Marekani ikiwa kwenye ardhi ya Makka na Madina, ikiunga mkono Israel dhidi ya Wapalestina, ikiweka vikwazo dhidi ya Iraq ambavyo vilisababisha vifo vya raia, na wakati huo huo ikilinda tawala za kidikteta katika nchi za Kiislamu.

Mwaka 1988, Osama aliunda mtandao wa Al-Qaeda. Kadiri hasira yake ilivyozidi kuongezeka, ndivyo msimamo wake ulivyozidi kuwa mkali. Mwaka 1996 na tena mwaka 1998, alitangaza wazi vita, au jihad, dhidi ya Marekani na washirika wake. Kuanzia hapo, Marekani ilianza kukumbana na mashambulizi yaliyowachanganya na kuwavuruga. Akala mo’y simpleng salita o senyas lang ang gheebah (paninirang-puri o panlilibak), ngunit sa katotohanan, ito ay mas mabigat pa kaysa sa maraming malalaking kasalanan gaya ng zinā. Hindi lamang ito simpleng kasalanan ng dila, isa rin ito sa mga sanhi ng parusa sa libingan at nagiging dahilan ng pagpasok sa Impiyerno.

Marami ang umiiwas na pag-usapan ito dahil sa guilt. Halos lahat tayo, sinasadya man o hindi, nagagawa ito. Nasasaksihan natin ang gheebah sa bahay, paaralan, palengke, kalsada, madrasah, at kahit sa masjid. Nakakalungkot isipin na kahit ang ilan sa mga naturingang may kaalaman o nag-aral ng Islam ay hindi nakaligtas sa kasalanang ito. Yan ang katotohanan, isang kasalanang laganap ngunit kadalasan ay binabalewala. Nawa'y patawarin tayo ng Allāh.

Bakit ito napakatindi?
Sapagkat sinisira mo ang buhay ng ibang tao. Sinisiraan mo siya sa harap ng iba, hinihimok mo ang iba na kamuhian siya dahil sa tsismis o sabi-sabi, at ninanakaw mo ang kanyang kapayapaan ng isip. Ang simpleng salita o senyas na iniisip mong walang epekto ay maaaring magdulot ng napakalaking pinsala sa reputasyon, dangal, at kaligayahan ng kapwa.

Ang Allāh ay Ganap na Makatarungan, at ayaw Niya ng pang-aapi o paglabag sa karapatan ng ibang tao. Kaya inilarawan Niya ang gheebah sa pinakamasahol na paraan:

“At huwag kayong manira sa isa’t isa, at huwag kayong manukso o manira ng kapwa sa pamamagitan ng paninirang-puri. Gusto ba ng sinuman sa inyo na kainin ang laman ng kapatid niya na patay? Hindi niyo ito gusto. Kaya mag-ingat kayo sa Allāh. Katotohanan, Siya ay Tumatanggap ng Tawbah at Maawain.”
(Surah al-Hujurāt 49:12)

Ang gheebah(panlilibak o paninirang-puri) ay hindi lang basta salita o senyas, ito ay may malubhang epekto.

Una, isa ito sa mga dahilan ng parusa sa libingan. 

Pangalawa, ang iyong mga mabubuting gawa ay maaaring mapunta sa taong iyong nilibak. Ang gantimpala ng iyong salāh, pag-aayuno, sadaqah, at adhkār ay maaaring mawala sa iyo dahil sa iisang kasalanang ito.

Panghuli, ayon sa hadith, ang mga gumagawa ng gheebah ay inilarawan na may mga kuko na tanso, at gamit ito ay kinakaliskis nila ang kanilang mukha at dibdib. Sila ang mga kumakain ng laman ng tao at sumisira sa dangal ng iba.

Sa kabilang buhay, pananagutin ka sa lahat ng sinabi mo:

“Wala siyang nasasabi na salita, kundi mayroong tagapagmasid na handa at laging nagbabantay sa kanya.”
(Surah Qāf 50:18)

Tandaan:

Ang gheebah o paninirang-puri ay hindi nabubura ng salāh, sadaqah, sawm, dhikr, o hajj.
Kailangan nito ng tunay na tawbah at pag-aayos sa karapatan ng kapwa.

Paano ang kaffārah (pagbabayad-sala)?
-Kung alam ng siniraan, lapitan siya at humingi ng kapatawaran.
-Kung hindi niya alam, ipanalangin siya, humingi ng tawad sa Allāh para sa kanya, at banggitin ang kanyang mabubuting katangian sa mga pagtitipong dati mo siyang siniraan o nilibak.

Kaya sa panahon ngayon, ang taong umiwas sa mga pagtitipong puno ng tsismisan, paninirang-puri, at walang saysay na usapan; tunay na nagtagumpay. Sapagkat ang mga ganoong pagtitipong ay tahimik na nagsusunog ng mabubuting gawa, at maraming tao ang hindi namamalayang bawat salita ay may kaakibat na parusa.

At tandaan din: ang gheebah ay isa rin sa mga dahilan kung bakit nagiging mahirap at miserable ang buhay, kulang ang rizq, nawawala ang barakah, at nababawasan ang tawfīq. 

Kaya mag-ingat tayo sa ating mga salita at senyas, at sikaping panatilihin ang karapatan at dangal ng kapwa.

Paalaala:
 Ayon sa mga 'Ulamā' ng Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jamā‘ah):
May ilang sitwasyon kung saan pinahihintulutan ng Islam ang Gheebah para sa Ahl al-Bid‘ah, ngunit may mahigpit na hangganan:
-Maaari lamang itong banggitin kung kinakailangan, gaya ng pagbibigay-babala sa kanilang mga gawain o paniniwala na taliwas sa Islam.
-Hindi ito puwedeng gamitin bilang dahilan upang sirain ang reputasyon ng isang tao sa kanilang personal na buhay, kakulangan, o mga problema.

KILA ANAYETEULIWA AU KUFANYA KAZI KWENYE MAMLAKA ZA USIMAMIZI WA SHERIA AU UDHIBITI ANATUMWA KUTEKELEZA SHERIA BILA KUJALI UZURI AU UBAYA WA SHERIA HIZO

Ndugu zangu

Leo tuzungumzie watumishi wanaofanya kazi kwenye taasisi mbalimbali za serikali hasa zile zenye majukumu ya kiudhibiti kama vile, Jeshi la Polisi, LATRA, TANROADS, TARURA, NK. Tumezoea kuona taasisi hizi zikiwa na nafasi za uteuzi na pia nafasi za watendaji wa kawaida. Kwa mfano, katika Jeshi la Polisi, kuna Mkuu wa Jeshi (CPF), kuna Makamishna, kuna ma-RPC, kuna ma-RTO, DTOs, nk. Kule LATRA kuna Mkurugenzi Mkuu, Wakurugenzi, Mameneja, Maafisa Wafawidhi, na wafanyakazi wa kawaida. Taasisi nyingine zote pia zina muundo unaofanana na huo kutegemea kama ni taasisi ya kijeshi au ni ya Kiraia. Taasisi hizi kwa kiasi kikubwa zinakuwa zimeanzishwa kwa mujibu wa Sheria na kupewa Mamlaka(Authority) au Nguvu (powers) na sheria ya Bunge. Kwa mfano:

1. JESHI LA POLISI = Sheria ya Jeshi la Polisi na Polisi Wasaidizi;

2. LATRA = Sheria ya Mamlaka ya Udhibiti wa Usafiri Ardhini

3. TANROADS/TARURA = Sheria ya Barabara na Sheria ya Wakala za Serikali.

Kwa mfano, Kifungu cha 5 cha Sheria ya Jeshi la Polisi kinatoa wajibu ufuatao kwa Jeshi

(a) Kutunza amani;
(b) Kusimamia sheria na amri;
(c) Kukamata na kuwalinda watuhumiwa;
(d) Kulinda mali;
(e) Kutekeleza majukumu mengine kadiri watakavyoelekezwa

Kifungu cha 5 cha Sheria ya LATRA kinasema kwamba LATRA itatekeleza majukumu yafuatayo:

(a) Kutekeleza majukumu yote yaliyowekwa kwa Mamlaka na sheria nyingine za kisekta;
(b) Kutoa, kuhuisha na kufuta leseni vibali au leseni;
(c) Kulingana na sheria ya kisekta,

a. Kuweka viwango vya huduma na bidhaa;
b. Kuweka viwango vya masharti ya utoaji huduma na bidhaa;
c. Kurekebu viwango na tozo
(d) Kusajili watumishi  na kuthibitisha madereva wa huduma zinazodhibitiwa
(e) Kufuatilia ufanisi wa huduma zinazodhibitiwa
(f) Kuwezesha utatuzi wa migogoro, nk.

Kwa hiyo Jeshi la Polisi au LATRA, wanapofanya chochote kinachoendana na majukumu tajwa hapo juu, HAWAJIPENDELEI TU BALI WANALAZIMISHWA NA SHERIA, Kushindwa kutimiza majukumu hayo ni kushindwa kutimiza wajibu wao.

Kwa hiyo basi, yeyote anayeteuliwa kuwa IGP au kuwa Mkurugenzi Mkuu au Mtendaji Mkuu majukumu hayo ndio hadidu zake za kwanza za rejea. Akishindwa kuyatimiza anahalalisha kuondolewa kwake. Sasa IGP au DG wa LATRA hawezi kufanya majukumu yote hayo peke yake, anasaidiwa na wasaidizi niliowataja hapo awali pamoja na wafanyakazi wa ngazi za chini. Kwa hiyo popote pale utakapoona mfanya kazi au askari anatekeleza jukumu Fulani ujue anafanya hivyo kwa niaba ya Mkurugenzi wake au Boss Mkuu wa kazi ukipenda.

Kwa hiyo, atatekeleza tu sheria iliyopo mbele yake iwe nzuri au mbaya. Kwa nini? Kwa sababu yeye siye anayetunga sheria, hawezi kwa namna yoyote ile kubadili hiyo sheria hata kama hata yeye mwenyewe anaiona mbaya. Anachoweza kufanya ni kutumia busara tu katika utekelezaji. Lakini kumbuka Busara sio sheria. Hata kama ni kanuni ukumbuke kanuni zinatengenezwa na Waziri na kubadili kanuni pia ni mchakato. Sheria ya Bunge ndio kabisaa.

Ndio maana leo hii ukimuuliza askari hivi kosa la kuovateki ungependa faini yake iwe shilingi ngapi? Atakuambia 50,000 au 100,000, lakini ndio hawezi badili chochote. Hata upige ovateki mbaya kiasi gani ataishia kukupiga faini 30,000. Boda boda hata alete vurugu namna gani barabarani ataishia kumlipisha 10,000. Wewe hapo ungependa wanaosababisha ajali kwa unachokiona kama ni makusudi barabarani wauawe au wachapwe viboko 20, lakini ndio sheria haisemi hivyo. Mtu anaweza kukugonga hadi akuvunje miguu lakini Mahakamani ataishia kulipa 50,000 tu wakati wewe umelala miezi 6 unauguza mguu.

Kama tumeelewa mfano wa faini hapo juu, basi tujue na kwa watendaji ndio hivyo hivyo hawawezi kubadili yale ambayo sisi tunayoyaona ni sheria mbaya. Sana sana wanaweza kushauri. Lakini ushauri wao si lazima uchukuliwe atii. Na wasipotekeleza hiyo sheria nyie mnayoiona mbaya, wana adabishwa. Mzizi upo kuleee Bungeni zinakoanzia sheria, wabunge wakiwa makini wakatunga sheria nzuri, sisi wananchi tukapeleka maoni jengefu, matokeo ni kuwa na sheria nzuri.

The UAE’s engagement in Somalia dates back to the early 1990s, when it participated in UN humanitarian and peacekeeping missions amid prolonged civil war. Its role later expanded through involvement in the Puntland Maritime Police Force, in a region itself at odds with Mogadishu, and through financial and security support aimed at countering the militant group al-Shabaab, with Emirati forces at times drawn into local political disputes.

A decisive shift occurred in 2016, when Abu Dhabi signed an agreement with Somaliland granting it a 30-year lease to establish a base at Berbera airport, less than 300 kilometres from Yemen. Berbera, the region’s main port and commercial centre, has long been regarded as one of the Horn of Africa’s most strategic harbours, attracting growing international attention since Somaliland’s unilateral declaration of independence in 1991.

Nchi Kadhaa Zatoa Tahadhari za Dharura za Kusafiri Huku Mvutano na Machafuko Iran Yakiongezeka

Serikali za Uingereza, India, Canada, Urusi na Uturuki zimetoa tahadhari za dharura kwa raia wao kuhusu safari kuelekea au kupitia Iran, zikionya juu ya uwezekano wa kuongezeka ghafla kwa machafuko ya kiusalama kutokana na hali tete inayoendelea kushuhudiwa nchini humo.

 Tahadhari hizo zinakuja wakati Iran ikikabiliwa na machafuko ya ndani, maandamano ya wananchi yanayoendelea, na kauli kali za kijeshi zinazoongeza hofu ya kuzuka kwa mzozo mkubwa zaidi.

Kwa mujibu wa maelezo ya maafisa wa nchi hizo, hali ya usalama nchini Iran imekuwa isiyotabirika, huku maandamano yakiripotiwa katika miji kadhaa kutokana na kuporomoka kwa uchumi, kushuka kwa thamani ya sarafu ya rial, na kupanda kwa gharama za maisha. 

Mataifa hayo yameonya kuwa maandamano yanaweza kubadilika ghafla na kuwa makali, na kusababisha hatari kwa raia wa kigeni, ikiwemo kuzuiwa kwa harakati, kufungwa kwa barabara, au hata kukamatwa bila taarifa ya awali.

Tahadhari hizo pia zimechochewa na ongezeko la kauli za vitisho kati ya Iran na mataifa ya nje, hususan Marekani na washirika wake, pamoja na harakati za kijeshi katika eneo la Mashariki ya Kati.

 Maafisa wa kidiplomasia wameeleza kuwa hali ya sasa inaweza kubadilika kwa haraka, na kwamba mashambulizi ya kijeshi, vikwazo vipya, au hatua za kiusalama zinaweza kuchukuliwa bila onyo la mapema.

Serikali ya Uingereza imewashauri raia wake kuepuka safari zisizo za lazima kwenda Iran, huku India na Canada zikisisitiza raia wao waliopo nchini humo kuwa waendelee kuwa waangalifu, wafuatilie taarifa za ubalozi, na waandae mipango ya dharura endapo hali itazorota zaidi.

 Urusi na Uturuki pia zimetoa tahadhari kwa raia wao, zikisisitiza umuhimu wa kuepuka maeneo ya mikusanyiko ya watu na maandamano.

Wachambuzi wa masuala ya kimataifa wanasema hatua ya mataifa kadhaa kutoa tahadhari kwa wakati mmoja inaashiria wasiwasi mkubwa wa kimataifa kuhusu uthabiti wa Iran.

 Wanaeleza kuwa mchanganyiko wa matatizo ya kiuchumi, shinikizo la kisiasa, na mvutano wa kijeshi ni hali hatari ambayo inaweza kusababisha mlipuko wa ghafla wa machafuko.

Kwa upande wake, serikali ya Iran imeendelea kueleza kuwa hali iko chini ya udhibiti na kwamba maandamano yanachochewa na “nguvu za nje”. 

Hata hivyo, tahadhari hizi za kimataifa zinaonyesha kuwa jumuiya ya kimataifa inaona hatari halisi ya kuongezeka kwa mgogoro, jambo linalowafanya wasafiri na wawekezaji kuwa na tahadhari kubwa.

Kadiri hali inavyoendelea kubadilika, macho ya dunia yanaendelea kuelekezwa Iran, huku kukiwa na hofu kwamba msukosuko wa ndani unaweza kuathiri usalama wa kikanda na hata wa kimataifa.

Mbunge wa Urusi Ataka Jibu la Kijeshi Dhidi ya Marekani Baada ya Kukamatwa kwa Meli ya Urusi

Naibu mkuu wa kamati ya ulinzi ya Bunge la Urusi (Duma), Alexei Zhuravlev, ametoa kauli kali akisema kuwa Urusi inapaswa kutoa jibu la kijeshi dhidi ya Marekani, kufuatia tukio la kukamatwa kwa meli yenye bendera ya Urusi na majeshi ya Marekani mapema leo. 

Kauli hiyo imeongeza mvutano wa kisiasa na kiusalama kati ya mataifa hayo mawili yenye nguvu kubwa kijeshi, huku jumuiya ya kimataifa ikifuatilia kwa karibu hatima ya tukio hilo.

Akizungumza na vyombo vya habari vya Urusi, Zhuravlev alieleza kuwa hatua ya Marekani ya kuikamata meli hiyo ni ukiukwaji wa wazi wa sheria za kimataifa za baharini, na akaionya Washington kwamba vitendo vya aina hiyo haviwezi kuachwa bila majibu.

 Kwa mujibu wa mbunge huyo, Urusi inapaswa kuonesha msimamo thabiti ili kulinda heshima yake ya kitaifa, maslahi yake ya kimkakati, na usalama wa mali zake katika maji ya kimataifa.

Zhuravlev alisema kuwa kuendelea kwa kile alichokitaja kama “uchokozi wa Marekani” kunaweka dunia katika hatari ya kuingia katika mgogoro mkubwa wa kijeshi, hasa ikizingatiwa hali ya sasa ya mvutano unaohusisha masuala ya nishati, vikwazo vya kiuchumi, na migogoro ya kikanda. 

Alisisitiza kuwa Urusi ina haki ya kujilinda na kujibu kwa mujibu wa sheria za kimataifa endapo mali zake au raia wake watahatarishwa.

Tukio la kukamatwa kwa meli hiyo limekuja katika kipindi ambacho uhusiano kati ya Moscow na Washington tayari uko katika hali mbaya, kufuatia migogoro ya kisiasa, kiuchumi na kiusalama katika maeneo mbalimbali ya dunia. 

Wachambuzi wa masuala ya kimataifa wanasema kauli ya Zhuravlev, ingawa ni ya mbunge mmoja, inaakisi hasira inayoongezeka ndani ya duru za kisiasa za Urusi, na inaweza kuongeza shinikizo kwa Kremlin kuchukua hatua kali zaidi.

Hadi sasa, serikali ya Urusi haijatoa tamko rasmi la kuthibitisha hatua zozote za kijeshi, huku Wizara ya Ulinzi na Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje zikitarajiwa kutoa msimamo wao rasmi kuhusu tukio hilo. 

Kwa upande wake, Marekani haijajibu moja kwa moja kauli ya Zhuravlev, lakini imekuwa ikisisitiza mara kwa mara kuwa hatua zake dhidi ya meli mbalimbali zinazingatia sheria za kimataifa na masuala ya usalama wa kitaifa.

Jumuiya ya kimataifa imeanza kuonesha wasiwasi mkubwa kuhusu mwelekeo wa mvutano huu, huku baadhi ya wachambuzi wakionya kuwa kauli za vitisho vya kijeshi zinaweza kuchochea msururu wa matukio hatari endapo hazitadhibitiwa kupitia njia za kidiplomasia. 

Kadiri hali inavyoendelea, macho ya dunia yanaelekezwa kwa Moscow na Washington, huku kukiwa na hofu kwamba tukio la meli linaweza kuwa chanzo cha mzozo mpana zaidi kati ya mataifa makubwa ya kijeshi duniani.

Sumber kebenaran final
Penentu keselamatan atau kesesatan
Pemberi makna hidup

Skeptisisme dianggap dosa, bukan metode berpikir.

kemampuan menunda kepastian
keberanian menerima ambiguitas
kesiapan merevisi keyakinan

kepastian instan
hitam–putih
jawaban cepat atas kecemasan hidup

Skeptisisme bukan ditolak karena salah,

secara otomatis menghancurkan:
kultus sanad absolut
klaim “manhaj paling lurus”
otoritas spiritual eksklusif

guru bisa salah
mazhab bisa keliru
kelompok bisa sesat

kekuasaan simbolik runtuh

Yang disakralkan bukan kasyf,

berdiri sendiri
bertanggung jawab atas iman

tempat berlindung eksistensial
“ayah metafisik”
pengganti kecemasan akan kebebasan

Anxiety is the dizziness of freedom.

فَاللَّهُمَّ صَلَاةً فِي بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى، وَصَلَاةً فِي مَكَّةَ الْمُكَرَّمَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ.

مَسْجِدُ السَّيِّدَةِ زَيْنَبَ: عَقِيلَةُ بَنِي هَاشِمٍ وَقِبْلَةُ الْمُحِبِّينَ

مُقَدِّمَةٌ

يُعَدُّ مَسْجِدُ السَّيِّدَةِ زَيْنَبَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهَا وَاحِدًا مِنْ أَهَمِّ وَأَعْظَمِ الْمَسَاجِدِ التَّارِيخِيَّةِ فِي مِصْرَ، وَيَحْتَلُّ مَكَانَةً خَاصَّةً فِي قُلُوبِ الْمِصْرِيِّينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ كَافَّةً. يَقَعُ الْمَسْجِدُ فِي الْحَيِّ الَّذِي يَحْمِلُ اسْمَهَا "حَيُّ السَّيِّدَةِ زَيْنَبَ" بِقَلْبِ الْقَاهِرَةِ، حَيْثُ يُمَثِّلُ مَرْكَزًا لِلْإِشْعَاعِ الرُّوحِيِّ وَالثَّقَافِيِّ.

صَاحِبَةُ الْمَشْهَدِ (السَّيِّدَةُ زَيْنَبُ)

هِيَ السَّيِّدَةُ زَيْنَبُ بِنْتُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، حَفِيدَةُ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ، وَأُمُّهَا هِيَ السَّيِّدَةُ فَاطِمَةُ الزَّهْرَاءُ. لُقِّبَتْ بِـ "عَقِيلَةِ بَنِي هَاشِمٍ"، وَتُعْرَفُ فِي مِصْرَ بِأَلْقَابٍ عِدَّةٍ مِنْهَا: "رَئِيسَةُ الدِّيوَانِ"، وَ "أُمُّ الْهَوَاشِمِ"، وَ "صَاحِبَةُ الشُّورَى". قَدِمَتْ إِلَى مِصْرَ بَعْدَ مَوْقِعَةِ كَرْبَلَاءَ، وَاسْتَقْبَلَهَا أَهْلُ مِصْرَ بِالتَّرْحَابِ وَالْحُبِّ الشَّدِيدِ.

تَارِيخُ الْمَسْجِدِ وَالْعِمَارَةُ

مَرَّ الْمَسْجِدُ بِتَطَوُّرَاتٍ مِعْمَارِيَّةٍ كَبِيرَةٍ عَبْرَ التَّارِيخِ:

النَّشْأَةُ: أُقِيمَ الْمَسْجِدُ فَوْقَ ضَرِيحِ السَّيِّدَةِ زَيْنَبَ بَعْدَ وَفَاتِهَا فِي مِصْرَ سَنَةَ 62هـ.

Bishii Nofeembar, Taliyaha Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliya, Jeneraal Odowaa Yuusuf Raage, ayaa Baarlamaanka u sheegay in inta u dhaxaysa 10,000 ilaa 15,000 askari ay ku dhinteen ama ku dhaawacmeen dagaallo intii lagu jiray saddexdii sano ee la soo dhaafay.

Bryden waa aasaasaha xarunta Sahan, oo ah xarun cilmi-baaris iyo siyaasad diiradda saarta amniga Geeska Afrika.

Tabar-darrada ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya ayaa ka dhigtay in dowladda federaalka ah ay ku tiirsanaato Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya. Qaar ka mid ah dadka falanqeeya siyaasadda waxay rumeysan yihiin in isku dayada Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ee wax ka beddelka dastuurka, hirgelinta nidaam doorasho oo cusub iyo dib u habeynta qaabka federaalka ay muujinayaan rabitaankiisa ah inuu sii joogo xukunka ka dib dhammaadka muddadiisa bisha Maay 2026. Sida uu Bryden sheegay, arrintan waxay keentay in siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliyeed ay kala qeybsamaan oo aysan awoodin inay mideeyaan safkooda si ay ula dagaallamaan Al-Shabaab.

Inkasta oo guulahaas la gaaray, Bryden wuxuu qoray in badbaadinta Soomaaliya “godka madow” ay ka badan tahay caqabadda siyaasadeed tan milatari.

“Al-Shabaab waxaa kaliya lagu jebin karaa hawlgallo militari oo isku mar laga sameeyo meelo kala duwan, iyadoo ujeeddada istiraatiijiyadeed ay tahay burburinta saldhigyadooda waaweyn ee Dooxada Webiga Jubba iyo Koonfur-galbeed Soomaaliya,” ayuu Bryden qoray. “Taasna waxaa lagu gaari karaa oo kaliya in si wadajir ah loo adeegsado ciidamada maamul-goboleedyada, iyadoo cutubyo federaal ah ay door taageero ah qaataan. Mifuko ya uwekezaji (mf. UTT AMIS)
Amana za benki

Siku ya leo tuangazie kipengele cha MIFUKO YA UWEKEZAJI.

Ngoja nijaribu kuelezea... Mifuko ya uwekezaji ni mfumo ambao watu wengi wanaweka pesa zao pamoja, kisha kampuni ya wataalamu inazichukua hizo pesa inakwenda kuziwekeza kwenye maeneo yenye usalama mwingi na hatari kidogo katika mambo ya uwekezaji.

Maeneo hayo ni kama vile kwenye Hatifungani za Serikali, Amana za Benki na Hisa za makampuni makubwa. Yaani wanafanya biashara ya uwekezaji kwa niaba yako.

Tupo pamoja?

Kwa mfano: Kuna shamba lenye thamani ya Tsh. Milioni 1. Wewe mfukoni una laki 1 pekee. Hii inamaanisha huwezi kulikodi. Sasa hapo ulipo kuna mtu ana laki 4, mwingine laki 2 na mwingine laki 3, ukiongezeka na wewe mwenye laki 1 mnapata uwezo wa kulikodi shamba hilo. 

Hapo kila mtu anatoa kiasi alichonacho anaweka kwenye mfuko wa uwekezaji wa pamoja. Tayari pesa ya kukodi inapatikana. 

Shambani, kunakuwa na msimamizi ambaye atasimamia hizo pesa kwa kuhakikisha shamba linalimwa kisasa, mazao yanavunwa na kuuzwa, atapambana na vishoka na madalali huko sokoni kisha mwisho wa siku ataleta faida ili kila mmoja agawiwe faida iliyopatikana kulingana na pesa aliyotoa. 

Tuendelee…

Katika muktadha wa kifedha na mambo ya uwekezaji ukisikia Unit Trust, Mutual Fund au Investment Fund ujue mfumo wa utendaji kazi wa hivyo vitu ni uleule wa watu kuleta pesa pamoja, kisha zinasimamiwa na kuwekezwa kwa niaba ya watu hao, halafu wanagawiwa faida inatoka kulingana na kiwango cha uwekezaji wa mtu, malengo na utendaji wa mfuko.

Tanzania tuna UTT AMIS (Asset Management and Investor Services) kama kampuni inayosimamia mifuko ya uwekezaji. Kumbuka ule mfano wa shamba.

Sasa katika huu uwekezaji utasikia sana neno kipande au vipande. Ni kwamba kwenye huu uwekezaji pesa yako itapimwa kwa vipande (units). Tuseme labda kipande kimoja ni Sh. 100 na wewe umetoa Sh. 1,000, hapo tunasema unamiliki vipande 10. Kuuza na kununua vipande ni kazi inayofanyika ndani ya UTT AMIS iwe kwenye simu uliyojiungia, laptop au kwenye website. Sawa?

Tuendelee…
Mifuko ya uwekezaji inayosimamiwa na UTT AMIS ni:

Umoja Fund

Wekeza Maisha Fund

Watoto Fund

Jikimu Fund

Liquid Fund (Ukwasi)

Bond Fund

Hapa kila mfuko una malengo yake na utendaji wake. Mfano, kuna mfuko wa kuwekeza ada polepole. Kadiri unavyowekeza ndivyo faida pia inavyopanda. Kwa kuwa biashara inafanyika huko, vipande ulivyonunua vinapanda thamani; hii inamaanisha ukizidisha idadi ya vipande unavyomiliki mara thamani iliyoongezeka, unapata kiasi cha faida.

Mara nyingi hii mifuko huonyesha kiwango cha asilimia ya riba unayoweza kupata. Wanaiita Return ambayo inaweza kubadilika-badilika. Unaweza kusikia kwa mwaka unapata asilimia 12 ya kile ulichowekeza mwaka unaofuata ikawa asilimia 14. Hii ina maanisha thamani ya kipande chako inakua. Inaweza pia kushuka kidogo kulingana na soko linavyokwenda.

Kuna mifuko utapokea pesa cash kila mwezi na ipo ambayo pesa yako itaendelea kuongezeka ndani ya mfuko na utaiona faida hiyokwa cash pale utakapoamua kuuza vipande vyako.

Natamani kuongelea mfuko mmoja mmoja na namna unavyofanya kazi au faida zake lakini, hata wewe ni shahidi post itakuwa ndefu mno. Niwaachie homework ama wenye kuweza kuidadavua kwenye comment wafanye hivyo kwa faida ya wote.

Ila pia hii ni kazi ya Investment Advisor kukudadavulia kila kitu kwa undani zaidi ili kabla ya hujaamua kuwekeza ujue fika unataka mfuko gani na kwa nini kulingana na pesa uliyonayo, malengo yako nk.

Muhimu: umeona kuna mfuko wa Bond Fund (Hatifungani). Huu mfuko wa hatifungani wa UTT na ile Hatifungani ya moja kwa moja ya BOT zinatofautiana.

Kwenye UTT (Bond Fund): Pesa uliyoweka kwenye mfuko ni kama mtaji. Faida inayopatikana inaungana na mtaji wako hapo kwenye mfuko (Re-investment). Kama uliweka Tsh. 100,000 na umepata faida ya 20,000 basi mtaji wako utasoma 120,000 na gawio lijalo litakokotoa mtaji na faida mpya iliyoingia.

Kwenye BOT: Mtaji haukui, ila unalipwa faida (coupon) kila baada ya miezi sita moja kwa moja kwenye akaunti yako ya benki mpaka mwisho wa biashara, kisha unapewa kile ulichowekeza/ kukopesha. Pia hapa pana kikomo cha ile miaka mliyokubaliana kukopeshana.

Bado hujaelewa hata kidogo?
Nikirejea nitaongelea kidogo tu kuhusu Amana za benki. Kisha uwekezaji namba moja utakuwa umekamilika.

Kama hakuna mti wa kutungua noti, basi hata 100 inayoongezeka katika uwekezaji wako ithamini.

Message to the Muslim Community of Arua Muslim District

Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm

Dear respected brothers and sisters in Islam,

As we approach the period of elections, we remind ourselves that Islam teaches us responsibility, justice, wisdom, and unity in all our affairs. Elections are a test of our character, our discipline, and our commitment to peace.

Let us participate in this process with good intention (niyyah), seeking what is best for our community, our religion, and our country. We should choose leaders with integrity, trustworthiness, and fear of Allah, not based on hatred, tribalism, or personal interest.

We strongly urge all Muslims to:

Maintain peace and calm at all times

Avoid insults, provocation, lies, and division

Respect differing opinions with Islamic manners (akhlaq)

Reject violence, abuse, and misuse of places of worship for conflict

The masjid remains a place of ibadah, unity, and guidance, not division. Let us protect the dignity of Islam through our words and actions.

We make du‘ā’ that Allah grants us leaders who are just, sincere, and beneficial to the Ummah, and that He protects our district from fitnah, chaos, and harm.

May Allah unite our hearts, guide our choices, and keep Arua Muslim District peaceful before, during, and after the elections.

Wa-Allāhu waliyyu-t-tawfīq.

Yunus Yunus Yunus 
Secretary for Da'wa

En una de las zonas más castigadas por la violencia islamista en África, los cristianos perseguidos de Cabo Delgado, al norte de Mozambique, continúan dando testimonio de fe en medio del terror, la destrucción y la muerte. Mientras aldeas completas son arrasadas y templos cristianos incendiados, creyentes locales aseguran estar presenciando milagros sobrenaturales que fortalecen su esperanza en medio del sufrimiento.

Desde 2018, esta región vive bajo una ofensiva constante de grupos extremistas vinculados al Estado Islámico y al-Shabaab, organizaciones que buscan imponer la sharia por la fuerza. Para estos grupos, los cristianos representan un enemigo directo: comunidades enteras han sido desplazadas, familias asesinadas y líderes religiosos ejecutados públicamente para sembrar miedo.

En enero de 2024, el Estado Islámico intensificó su campaña al emitir un llamado explícito a la violencia contra los creyentes bajo el lema: “Mátenlos dondequiera que los encuentren”. Este mensaje fue seguido por una ola de ataques en Mozambique, acompañados de imágenes de asesinatos y destrucción difundidas en Al-Naba, su revista oficial de propaganda.

La persecución ha sido vivida de cerca por la misionera Heidi Baker, quien lleva más de tres décadas sirviendo en el norte del país. Baker ha relatado cómo miembros de sus iglesias han sido asesinados, granjas y templos quemados, y creyentes ejecutados para intimidar a la población cristiana. En una ocasión, la violencia llegó hasta las cercanías de su propia vivienda, cuando se encontraron con un grupo armado de al-Shabaab portando machetes y fusiles AK-47.

A pesar del peligro, Heidi Baker y el equipo de Iris Global permanecen junto a los cristianos locales, brindando ayuda humanitaria y proclamando el mensaje de Jesús. Según la misionera, en medio de la persecución se ha manifestado durante años un mover sobrenatural de Dios, particularmente milagros de sanidad, especialmente la recuperación de la audición en personas sordas.

“Prácticamente cada semana vemos cómo Dios abre los oídos de los sordos”, afirmó Baker en un reciente video desde el terreno. Relató casos como el de Louisa, una mujer que había quedado sorda tras un fuerte golpe en la cabeza durante un ciclón. Tras la oración, recuperó completamente la audición. También mencionó a Francisco, un niño que apenas podía oír y hablar desde pequeño, y que después de ser sanado pudo pronunciar claramente: “Jesús te ama”.

Otros testimonios similares continúan surgiendo en aldeas y caminos rurales de Cabo Delgado, donde los cristianos oran en público a pesar del riesgo. Para Baker, estos hechos son una señal clara de que “Jesús sigue obrando incluso donde la persecución es más feroz”, recordando que la violencia no ha logrado apagar la fe de la Iglesia perseguida.

En una tierra marcada por el dolor, la sangre y el desplazamiento forzado, los creyentes en Mozambique afirman que la presencia de Dios sigue manifestándose, trayendo consuelo, sanidad y esperanza allí donde el extremismo intenta imponer el miedo.

Tidak Ada Alasan untuk Berhenti Belajar

Pada tahun lalu, kita banyak sekali kehilangan ulama besar Al-Azhar, diantaranya:

• As-Sayyid Prof. Dr. Ahmad Umar Hasyim Al-Husaini, Guru Besar Ilmu Hadis dan Ulum al-Hadis, Anggota Dewan Ulama Senior Al-Azhar, Mantan Rektor Universitas Al-Azhar sebelum Syaikhul Azhar Prof. Dr. Ahmad At-Thayyib, Anggota Majma‘ al-Buḥūṡ al-Islāmiyyah (Lembaga Riset Islam), dan Anggota Dewan Tertinggi Urusan Islam. Di antara karya monumentalnya adalah Faidh al-Bārī, syarah Shahih al-Bukhari yang terdiri dari tujuh jilid.

• Syaikh Prof. Dr. Mahmud Tawfiq Sa’d, Guru Besar Ilmu Balāghah dan Kritik Sastra, Anggota Dewan Ulama Senior Al-Azhar, Anggota Komite Tetap Kenaikan Jabatan Profesor Balāghah dan Kritik Sastra di Universitas Al-Azhar. Beliau adalah lautan dari lautan-lautan bahasa arab. Ia tidak pernah menuntut sesuatu pun dari urusan dunia, dan hidupnya diabdikan sepenuhnya untuk menuntut ilmu serta menyebarkannya.

• Syaikh Prof. Dr. Muhammad Husain Al-Mahrashawi, Guru Besar Linguistik, Mantan Rektor Universitas Al-Azhar, Mantan Ketua Akademi Global Al-Azhar untuk Pelatihan Para Imam dan Da‘i, Anggota Majma‘ al-Buḥūṡ al-Islāmiyyah (Lembaga Riset Islam). Ia adalah teladan kemuliaan dan kewibawaan para ulama, serta contoh nyata dalam keikhlasan kepada agamanya, tanah airnya, dan Al-Azhar Asy-Syarif.

Wafatnya seorang ulama merupakan kehilangan besar bagi umat. Sebab, seorang ulama tidak lahir secara instan, melainkan terbentuk melalui jerih payah yang panjang, kesungguhan yang luar biasa, dan proses keilmuan yang sangat lama.

Syekh Prof. Dr. Mahmud Abdurrahman Abdul Mun’im, guru besar Ushul Fikih di Al-Azhar, pernah berkata:

“Tiga ratus hadis seharusnya dapat dihafal oleh anak muda seperti kalian dalam satu pekan. Orang tua seperti saya mampu menghafal tiga puluh halaman dalam satu hari. Demi Allah, saya menghafal tiga puluh halaman sehari, bukan sekali dua kali. Adapun kadar normalnya adalah dua puluh hingga dua puluh lima halaman setiap hari.”

Karena itu, saya kurang sependapat dengan anggapan bahwa “semakin bertambah usia, semakin sulit untuk menghafal”. Pernyataan semacam ini sering kali hanyalah alibi agar tidak dicap malas dalam belajar dan menghafal. Sejarah justru mencatat banyak ulama besar yang baru menekuni ilmu secara serius di usia senja, di antaranya Sulthānul ‘Ulamā’ Al-Imam ‘Izzuddin bin ‘Abdissalām.

Demikian pula Al-Imam Al-Qaffāl Ash-Shaghīr, salah satu guru besar ulama Khurasaniyyin dalam mazhab Syafi‘i. Beliau baru mendalami fikih secara serius pada usia tiga puluh tahun. 

Begitu juga Al-Faqih Sulaim bin Ayyub Ar-Razi Asy-Syafi‘i, yang mulai memperdalam fikih ketika usianya telah mencapai empat puluh tahun.

Dikisahkan oleh Sahl bin Bisyr:

Ketika aku masih kecil di kota Rayy, usiaku sekitar sepuluh tahun, aku pernah menghadiri majelis seorang syaikh yang mengajarkan bacaan Al-Qur’an. Syaikh itu berkata kepadaku, “Majulah dan bacalah.” Aku mencoba membaca Surah Al-Fatihah, tetapi tidak mampu karena lidahku terasa terkunci.

Syaikh itu bertanya, “Apakah engkau masih memiliki ibu?” Aku menjawab, “Ya.”
Beliau berkata, “Mintalah kepadanya agar mendoakanmu supaya Allah menganugerahkan kepadamu kemampuan membaca Al-Qur’an dan ilmu.”

Aku pun pulang dan memintanya berdoa untukku, lalu ia mendoakanku. Setelah aku dewasa, aku pergi ke Baghdad untuk mempelajari bahasa Arab dan fikih, kemudian kembali ke Rayy. Suatu hari aku sedang mengkaji Mukhtashar al-Muzani di masjid, tiba-tiba syaikh yang dahulu itu datang dan memberi salam, sementara ia tidak mengenaliku. Ia mendengar pembahasan kami, tetapi tidak memahaminya. Lalu ia berkata, “Kapan seseorang bisa belajar seperti ini?”

Aku hampir berkata kepadanya, “Jika engkau masih memiliki ibu, mintalah beliau agar mendoakanmu,” namun aku merasa malu untuk mengucapkannya.

Sahl bin Bisyr wafat karena tenggelam di Laut Qulzum (Laut Merah) dekat pantai Jeddah, sepulang menunaikan haji, pada bulan Shafar tahun 447 H, dalam usia lebih dari delapan puluh tahun.

Termasuk pula Asbagh bin Al-Faraj Al-Maliki, Mufti Mesir pada masa Dinasti Abbasiyyah, yang baru menuntut ilmu di usia tua. Beliau adalah guru bagi para imam besar seperti Al-Imam Al-Bukhari, At-Tirmidzi, dan Yahya bin Ma‘in. Dan yang sudah sangat masyhur di kalangan penuntut ilmu ialah Syekh Khalid Al-Azhari.

Maka, tidak ada alasan bagi kita untuk berhenti belajar.

Jika alasan seseorang meninggalkan belajar adalah karena telah menikah, atau sibuk mengurus anak dan keluarga, maka renungkanlah kisah berikut ini:

Diriwayatkan bahwa Khadijah binti al-Faqih Umar bin Ahmad al-‘Amudi al-Hadhrami (wafat 948 H) menyalin dengan tangannya sendiri kitab Nihāyat al-Muhtāj Syarh al-Minhāj karya Imam Syamsuddin ar-Ramli, yang terdiri dari delapan jilid.

Pada akhir jilid kedelapan, ia menulis:

فليعذِرني من وقف على هذا الكتاب فإني كتبته وأنا أرضع ولدي فلانًا

“Kiranya siapa pun yang membaca kitab ini dapat memaklumi keadaanku, karena aku menulisnya sementara aku sedang menyusui anakku, Fulan.”

Kisah ini disebutkan dalam kitab Tāj al-‘Arūs.

Setiap orang yang menapaki jalan ilmu pasti akan diuji dengan cobaan yang berbeda-beda. Ketika tekad untuk belajar telah tumbuh, bersiaplah menghadapi seribu rintangan.

Imam Ibn Hazm ketika terjadi perdebatan antara beliau dengan imam besar Abu al-Walid al-Bāji al-Maliki, pensyarah al-Muwaṭṭaʼ, maka di akhir perdebatan itu Imam al-Bāji berkata kepadanya dengan penuh permintaan maaf:

تعذرني؛ فإن أكثر مطالعتي كان على سرج الحراس

“Jika dalam perdebatan tadi ada kekeliruan atau kekurangan dariku, maka maafkanlah aku; sebab dahulu aku menuntut ilmu di bawah pelita para penjaga malam.”

Maksudnya: pada masa itu belum ada listrik. Para penjaga (semacam petugas keamanan atau polisi) biasanya menjaga jalan-jalan, kota, atau desa dengan membawa obor yang menyala dari api, sambil berdiri di pos jaga mereka.

Hal ini sering terjadi pada banyak ulama yang hidup dalam keadaan sangat miskin, tidak memiliki minyak atau pelita untuk menerangi malam. Karena begitu besar kerinduan dan semangatnya untuk menuntut ilmu, Imam al-Bāji tidak dapat tidur; sementara ia tak punya penerangan. Maka ia keluar ke jalan, mendekati para penjaga yang membawa obor, dan belajar serta membaca di bawah cahaya obor mereka.

Maka Imam Ibn Hazm menjawab:

وتعذرني أيضاً، وأنا أحق بالعذر؛ فإن أكثر مطالعتي كان على منائر الذهب والفضة.

“Dan maafkan pula aku; dan akulah yang paling berhak untuk diberi maaf, sebab aku menuntut ilmu di bawah menara-menara emas dan perak.”

Maksudnya, Imam al-Bāji ingin mengatakan bahwa kemiskinan dan kesulitan menjadi penghalang baginya dalam menuntut ilmu, karena ia harus bersusah payah belajar di bawah obor para penjaga. Tetapi Imam Ibn Hazm membalas dengan makna yang lebih dalam:

Bahwa justru kemewahan dan kenikmatan hiduplah yang sering menjadi penghalang bagi seseorang untuk sungguh-sungguh menuntut ilmu. Sebab orang yang hidup dalam kemewahan - dengan segala kemudahan, uang, dan fasilitas - lebih mudah tergoda oleh kesenangan dunia, hingga lalai dari ilmu.

Seakan-akan Ibn Hazm ingin menegaskan bahwa kemewahan lebih berbahaya bagi penuntut ilmu daripada kemiskinan, karena kemewahan bisa mematikan semangat dan kesungguhan.

Dzhokhar Dudayev, Presiden Pertama Republik Chechnya

Bagaimana dua menit tambahan menyebabkan terlacaknya orang yang paling dicari Rusia di Chechnya dan pembunuhannya pada tahun 1996 M!

Dzhokhar Dudayev lahir pada 15 Februari 1944 di desa Yalkhoy-Mokhk, Chechnya. Namun, masa kecilnya tidak dihabiskan di sana karena keluarganya dideportasi secara paksa ke Kazakhstan (Sumber di poster menyebut Asia Tengah dan Siberia) sebagai bagian dari operasi penindasan yang dilakukan oleh Uni Soviet, di mana setengah juta Muslim Chechnya diusir dari tanah air mereka!

Ia baru kembali ke negaranya pada tahun 1957. Ia menyelesaikan pendidikannya, bergabung dengan Akademi Penerbangan Militer Rusia, dan meraih 12 medali penghargaan dari pemerintah Rusia, termasuk Bintang Kehormatan dan Bintang Jasa, hingga mencapai pangkat Mayor Jenderal. Ia menjadi Muslim pertama yang mencapai pangkat jenderal di Angkatan Udara Soviet.
Namun, Dudayev bukan sekadar seorang militer yang penuh dengan lencana kehormatan. Ia membawa mimpi yang membara di dadanya: kemerdekaan Chechnya dari cengkeraman pendudukan Rusia.

Seiring runtuhnya Uni Soviet pada tahun 1990, ia mengundurkan diri dari tentara Soviet dan kembali ke negaranya untuk memimpin Dewan Nasional serta memimpin organisasi bersenjata Chechnya. Ia memimpin serangan telak ke markas Partai Komunis—di mana gubernur Rusia dilempar dari jendela hingga tewas—kemudian mengambil alih gedung televisi, dan mendeklarasikan kemerdekaan Chechnya.

Pada Oktober 1991, Dudayev mengikuti pemilihan presiden dan meraih dukungan mutlak sebesar 85%, menjadikannya presiden pertama Republik Chechnya yang merdeka, sekaligus menantang Moskow secara langsung.

Rusia tidak menerima kemerdekaan ini. Presiden Rusia yang baru, Boris Yeltsin, menganggap Dudayev sebagai pelanggar hukum, lalu mengirim pasukan untuk mengepung Grozny dan menggabungkannya kembali ke Rusia.

Namun, Dudayev bukanlah orang yang mudah digertak. Ia mengepung balik pasukan Rusia dan memukul mundur tipu daya mereka. Ia mulai membangun tentara yang kuat dari para pejuang Chechnya yang berpengalaman, sebagai persiapan menghadapi perang yang ia tahu pasti akan datang.

Pada awalnya, Rusia terpaksa mundur, dan Chechnya menikmati ketenangan relatif antara tahun 1992 dan 1994. Namun, Moskow tidak lupa. Mereka mulai menanam milisi pro-Rusia di dalam Chechnya dan mengirim agen intelijen untuk merekrut tentara bayaran serta merencanakan kudeta.

Pada Desember 1994, Rusia memulai invasi terbukanya, yang menandai dimulainya Perang Chechnya Pertama.

Selama 30 hari penuh, pasukan Rusia tidak mampu bergerak maju ke dalam wilayah Chechnya. Kemudian dimulailah pengeboman brutal terhadap kota-kota, khususnya Grozny, di mana 60% bangunannya hancur lebur dan ribuan warga sipil tak berdosa tewas. Dudayev terpaksa mengevakuasi gedung kepresidenan dan berlindung di gudang rudal, sementara Rusia terus menyerbu negara itu.

Namun, pertempuran belum berakhir. Perang berubah dari perang nasionalis menjadi perang Islam dengan kembalinya Sh4mil B4sayev yang meminta bantuan para Mujahidin dari Dagestan, Abkhazia, dan Afghanistan, yang semakin menambah kekuatan perlawanan. Basayev beralih ke taktik perang gerilya dan menimbulkan kerugian besar bagi tentara Rusia.

Kemudian terjadilah operasi penyanderaan di rumah sakit Budyonnovsk, Rusia, pada tahun 1995, yang memaksa Moskow untuk bernegosiasi, memberikan kesempatan bagi perlawanan untuk mengatur ulang barisan mereka.

Setelah serangkaian operasi yang menguras tenaga, Rusia menyadari bahwa menghancurkan perlawanan Chechnya secara militer adalah hal yang mustahil. Maka, mereka memutuskan untuk menggunakan metode yang lebih presisi.

Dudayev adalah pria yang sangat waspada. Ia sadar bahwa intelijen Rusia sedang melacaknya, sehingga ia tidak pernah bermalam di satu tempat dalam waktu lama. Ia menggunakan alat komunikasi rahasia dan membatasi panggilan teleponnya seminimal mungkin—tidak lebih dari tiga menit—untuk menghindari pelacakan.
Namun, pada 21 April 1996, ia melakukan kesalahan fatal.
Dalam sebuah panggilan telepon, percakapan berlangsung selama 5 menit, bukan 3 menit. Momen itu cukup untuk menentukan lokasinya dengan tepat.

Di langit, pesawat Rusia A-50 yang memiliki spesialisasi dalam peringatan dini dan pengawasan sedang terbang mencari sinyal yang bisa mengungkap keberadaannya. Segera setelah koordinat teleponnya terdeteksi, dua rudal dipandu tipe Kh-25 diluncurkan dan mengenainya secara langsung.

Dudayev pun syahid—Insya Allah—bersama empat pengawal pribadinya, dalam sebuah peristiwa yang mengguncang Chechnya, namun tidak mematahkan perlawanan.

Ia digantikan oleh Zelimkhan Yandarbiyev yang menandatangani perjanjian gencatan senjata. Setelah itu, Boris Yeltsin mengumumkan kemenangan Rusia pada tahun 1996, namun kemenangan ini hanya bertahan selama tiga bulan saja.

Pada 6 Agustus 1996, Aslan Maskhadov, Shamil B4sayev, dan Khattab, dengan hanya 850 mujahidin, memimpin serangan besar-besaran ke Grozny. Rusia tidak mampu menahan mereka, dan penduduk kota pun bergabung dalam pertempuran, yang menyebabkan tewasnya ribuan tentara Rusia.

Rusia mengancam akan memusnahkan Grozny dengan senjata yang belum pernah digunakan sebelumnya. Namun pada akhirnya, Jenderal Alexander Lebed terpaksa menandatangani perjanjian gencatan senjata dengan Maskhadov pada 22 Agustus, yang mengakhiri Perang Pertama dengan kemenangan telak bagi Chechnya.

Namun konflik belum berakhir, karena para Mujahidin, yang dipimpin oleh Shamil B4sayev dan Khattab, melihat bahwa pertempuran yang sesungguhnya belum dimulai!

Dudayev telah syahid—Insya Allah—tetapi ia tidak mati dalam ingatan rakyat Chechnya. Ia tetap menjadi simbol keteguhan dan legenda hidup dalam sejarah perlawanan.

Satu orang pria, yang membuat Rusia berlutut secara militer untuk pertama kalinya pasca Perang Dingin!

Rais wa Jamhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania, Mhe. Dkt. Samia Suluhu Hassan, amesisitiza kuwa uhuru wa Mahakama na uadilifu wa majaji na mahakimu ni nguzo muhimu katika kuhakikisha haki inapatikana kwa wote na kukuza utawala bora nchini.

Akizungumza Januari 13, 2026, katika Mkutano Mkuu wa Chama cha Mahakimu na Majaji Tanzania (TMJA) jijini Dodoma, Rais Samia alibainisha kuwa Mahakama imara ndiyo msingi wa maendeleo endelevu ya Taifa. Aliwapongeza watumishi hao wa mhimili wa mahakama kwa kazi nzito wanayoifanya, akiwataka kuendelea kufanya kazi kwa weledi, busara, na ujasiri bila kuyumbishwa na rushwa au upendeleo.

Katika kuelekea utekelezaji wa Dira ya Taifa ya Maendeleo 2025–2050, Rais alieleza kuwa Mahakama ina nafasi ya pekee katika kulinda uwekezaji na maslahi ya Taifa kupitia utatuzi wa haki wa migogoro ya kibiashara, kodi, na mikataba.

"Serikali ya Awamu ya Sita itaendelea kuimarisha Mahakama kwa kuboresha miundombinu, kuongeza rasilimali watu, na kukuza matumizi ya TEHAMA ili kuharakisha utoaji wa haki," alisema Rais Samia.

Aidha, Rais alihakikisha kuwa Serikali itaendelea kuboresha mishahara na mazingira ya kazi kadiri uchumi unavyokua. Aidha, alibainisha kuwa changamoto zilizowasilishwa, ikiwemo migogoro ya ardhi na mapendekezo ya mabadiliko ya sheria, zimefanyiwa kazi na zitashughulikiwa kulingana na upatikanaji wa rasilimali.

Kwa upande mwingine, Rais Samia aliwataka majaji na mahakimu kusimamia Katiba na sheria bila woga wala chuki, akisisitiza kuwa jukumu lao kuu ni kulinda amani, usalama, na utulivu wa nchi kupitia utoaji wa haki.

El Adde: 15 January 2016.
In the early hours of Friday, 15 January 2016, before sunrise touched the dusty plains of El Adde, Somalia, a Kenyan flag fluttered quietly above a KDF camp that had stood there for years as part of the AMISOM mission.

It was around 5:30 a.m.
Most soldiers were just waking up.
Some were preparing for morning routines.
Some were thinking of home — of families in Kenya who believed the worst days were behind them.

Then the ground exploded.
A massive suicide vehicle bomb slammed into the camp gates, tearing through defenses built to withstand gunfire, not betrayal of dawn. Within moments, Al-Shabaab fighters poured in, launching one of the deadliest attacks ever faced by the Kenya Defence Forces.

The battle that followed was brutal and uneven.
On that morning of 15 January 2016, Kenyan soldiers fought with discipline and courage under overwhelming pressure. Communication lines failed. Ammunition ran low. Smoke and dust blurred friend from foe. Yet they held positions, protected each other, and resisted for hours.
Some were wounded and still fought.
Some shielded fellow soldiers with their own bodies.
Some never made it out.
By mid-morning, El Adde camp had been overrun.
Back in Kenya, the date would soon be etched into memory.

Families began hearing whispers. Phones went unanswered. The government confirmed that Kenyan soldiers had been killed, though exact numbers were not immediately released. Grief spread faster than official statements.

Mothers waited.
Wives hoped.
Children asked questions no one could answer.
In the days that followed, Kenya mourned quietly and painfully. The fallen were not just soldiers,they were young men who had deployed years earlier to protect a nation they loved, far from its borders.
El Adde, once a remote Somali town few Kenyans knew, became a symbol of sacrifice, loss, and unanswered questions.

To this day, 15 January 2016 remains one of the darkest dates in Kenya’s military history,not because of defeat, but because of the heavy price paid by those who stood their ground when the sun rose into fire.

They did not die nameless.
They did not die forgotten.

And every January, as the date returns, so do the memories, of courage, of silence, and of a morning that never truly ended.

**Quand le discours religieux devient un piège :
une mise en garde prophétique toujours actuelle**

À notre époque, nous assistons à un phénomène inquiétant au sein même de la communauté musulmane. Des personnes parlent abondamment de religion, invoquent le Coran, crient au tawḥîd (l’unicité d’Allah) et se présentent comme les défenseurs de la vérité. Pourtant, dans leurs paroles et leurs actes, ils sèment le désordre, attisent les conflits et accusent les autres musulmans de mécréance, de trahison ou d’hypocrisie.

Ce comportement n’est pas nouveau. Le Prophète ﷺ nous en a clairement avertis, dans un hadith authentique rapporté par Abû Sa‘îd al-Khudrî رضي الله عنه :

> « Il apparaîtra parmi vous des gens devant lesquels vous mépriserez votre prière par rapport à la leur et votre jeûne par rapport au leur.
Ils réciteront le Coran, mais il ne dépassera pas leurs gorges.
Ils sortiront de la religion comme la flèche traverse la proie.
Ils tueront les gens de l’Islam et laisseront les adorateurs d’idoles. »
— rapporté par Sahih al-Bukhari et Sahih Muslim

Une apparence pieuse, mais un cœur malade

Le Prophète ﷺ décrit des gens dont l’adoration semble impressionnante : prière, jeûne, récitation du Coran. Pourtant, leur compréhension est superficielle. Le Coran reste sur leurs langues, sans atteindre leurs cœurs ni transformer leur comportement.

Aujourd’hui encore, certains utilisent des mots religieux comme des armes :

ils traitent les autres musulmans de mécréants,

les accusent d’être des agents, des vendus ou des égarés,

divisent les familles, les mosquées et les communautés.

Alors qu’en réalité, ce sont eux qui provoquent le trouble, le désordre et le conflit intérieur (fitna), exactement comme l’a décrit le Prophète ﷺ.

L’Islam protège le sang, l’honneur et l’unité

L’un des principes fondamentaux de l’Islam est la protection :

du sang des musulmans,

de leur honneur,

et de l’unité de la communauté.

Accuser un musulman de mécréance (takfîr) est une affaire extrêmement grave. Les savants de l’Islam ont toujours rappelé que le takfîr sans science ni preuve claire est une porte vers la destruction de la Oumma.

👉 Celui qui prétend défendre l’Islam tout en semant la haine entre les croyants contredit l’esprit même de l’Islam, même s’il cite des versets ou des hadiths.

Une leçon pour notre temps

Ce hadith n’est pas seulement un récit historique. C’est une boussole pour notre époque :

La vérité ne se mesure pas à la dureté du discours

Ni au nombre d’accusations lancées

Mais à la justice, à la sagesse, à la miséricorde et au respect des limites posées par Allah

Comme l’ont rappelé les savants :

> « La déviation commence souvent par une mauvaise compréhension, pas par un manque de pratique. »

Conclusion

Face aux divisions actuelles, le musulman sincère doit faire preuve de prudence, de science et de bon comportement.
Appeler à Allah ne signifie pas déchirer la communauté. Défendre le tawḥîd ne signifie pas déclarer les autres musulmans ennemis.

🕊️ L’Islam est venu pour guider, réformer et unir — non pour diviser et détruire de l’intérieur.

M – WEKEZA

Msomaji mmoja aliomba kuelezwa kidogo kuhusu M-Wekeza. Hili halikuwa katika ratiba zangu. Lakini, ngoja nitii kiu yake. 

Tayari nilishawaeleza kuhusu mifuko ya uwekezaji ni nini na namna inavyofanya kazi. Si ndiyo?

Nilitoa mpaka mfano wa shamba ili unaposikia kitu kinaitwa mfuko wa uwekezaji uwe unajua ni kitu gani kinazungumziwa na kinafanyaje kazi.

Kwa kuwa umeshajua hilo, basi hata nitakapoelezea kuhusu M–Wekeza utaelewa haraka sana.

M–Wekeza ni nini?

Sikia... M–Wekeza ni jukwaa la uwekezaji wa pamoja ambalo unatumia huduma ya M-Pesa kuwekeza. Hii huduma ilizinduliwa na Vodacom ikishirikiana na kampuni ya uwekezaji inayoitwa Sanlam Investments East Africa. 

Jukwaa hili la uwekezaji lipo chini ya usimamizi wa Mamlaka ya Masoko ya Mitaji na Dhamana (CMSA). Hivyo ipo kihalali kabisa chini ya usimamizi wa kisheria.

Umeelewa?

Sasa kama nilivyokwambia, uwekezaji wa pamoja ni watu huleta pesa sehemu moja, kisha pesa hizo zinasimamiwa na kampuni na kuwekezwa kwenye vitu kama hatifungani za serikali, hisa za makampuni makubwa, mifuko mingine ya uwekezaji nk.

Msimamizi wa hizo pesa anakwenda kufanya biashara kwa niaba yako, kisha utagawiwa faida kulingana na utendaji kazi wa jukwaa au mfuko, na  kwa utaratibu mliokubaliana.

Kwenye M–Wekeza inakuwa hivi…

Sanlam Investments East Africa ndiye msimamizi anayekwenda kuwekeza sokoni hizo pesa zilizopatikana. Yaani zilizowekwa kwenye akaunti ya M - Wekeza.  Vodacom wao wametoa jukwaa la kuwezesha huu uwekezaji. Hivyo, utaweka pesa kwenye akaunti ya  M-Pesa kisha utahamishia kwenye akaunti ya M- Wekeza. 

Hiyo pesa utakayoingiza kwenye akaunti ya M-Wekeza ndiyo mtaji wako unaokwenda kuunganishwa na pesa za wengine na kisha kuingizwa kwenye biashara.

Tumeelewana?

Sasa umeshaweka pesa kwenye akaunti ya M–Wekeza, nini kinafuata?

⚡ Utapokea gawio kila mwezi kulingana na pesa iliyopo hapo kwenye akaunti ya M-Wekeza.

⚡ Unaweza kuongeza pesa ya mtaji kila ukijisikia na kukuza kiwango cha faida.

⚡ Katika M–Wekeza, mpaka sasa kwa mwaka unaweza kupata faida hadi ya asilimia 13% ya kile ulichowekeza.

Kwa mfano: kama umetunza hela ikafika milioni 1 kamili kwa mwaka mzima, basi utakuwa na faida ya TSh. 130,000. Hapo ni kama bado, asilimia za gawio kwa mwaka ni 13%, ikiongezeka na faida yako itapanda pia. Hii asilimia si kwamba itakaa hivyo miaka yote. 

Katika M–Wekeza kuna kitu kinaitwa Compound Interest.

Compound Interest ina maana kwamba faida unayopata inaunganishwa na ile pesa yako uliyoweka. Halafu vyote kwa pamoja  vitakokotolewa kwenye faida inayofuata.

Kwa mfano, kwa mwaka mzima umeweka milioni 1 na faida imekuwa 130,000. Minnesota imeingia kwenye hali ya taharuki baada ya vikwazo vya shirikisho vya Marekani kuanzisha operesheni kubwa ya kukamata wahamiaji, ikijulikana kama Operation Metro Surge.

Operesheni hiyo inahusisha maelfu ya maafisa wa shirikisho, wakiwemo wa ICE (Immigration and Customs Enforcement), Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) na Customs and Border Protection, waliotumwa katika eneo la Minneapolis–St. Paul.

Lengo la operesheni hii ni kukamata wahamiaji haramu, pamoja na wale wanaodaiwa kushiriki katika uhalifu wa uhusiano na masuala ya kisheria yanayohusiana na uhamiaji.

Taarifa zilizopatikana kutoka vyanzo vya habari vya kimataifa zinaonyesha kuwa maafisa wa shirikisho wamelazimika kutumia nguvu katika baadhi ya tukio, ikiwemo kuvunja madirisha ya magari na kuwatoa watu kutoka ndani ya magari kabla ya kuwasafirisha.

Hii imeibua hisia mchanganyiko katika jamii, huku baadhi ya mashirika ya haki za binadamu yakilalamika kuwa operesheni hiyo inakiuka haki za raia. Hata hivyo, vyanzo rasmi vya DHS (Department of Homeland Security) vinasema kwamba tukio hilo lilihusiana na mtu aliyekuwa na amri ya kuondolewa nchini Marekani na alikataa kushirikiana na maafisa wa shirikisho.

Hali hii ya kukamata na kutumia nguvu imechochea maandamano madogo na hisia kali za wananchi. Mashirika ya kiraia, yakiwemo ACLU ya Minnesota, yamelaani operesheni hiyo, yakiwaonya kuwa baadhi ya maafisa wanakiuka haki za kikatiba za raia, ikiwemo haki ya kujitetea na haki ya kushiriki kama mdadisi au mshuhudia wa operesheni.

Wanasiasa wa serikali ya Minnesota pia wameripotiwa kupinga operesheni hiyo, wakisisitiza kuwa ni kuingilia kwa nguvu katika masuala ya serikali ya mkoa.

Tukio hili limeibua mjadala mkali katika Marekani, likionyesha mgawanyiko wa kisiasa miongoni mwa raia na viongozi.

Wengine wanaunga mkono hatua ya shirikisho, wakiiona kama njia ya kudhibiti uhalifu unaohusiana na uhamiaji haramu na kudumisha usalama.

Wengine wanahoji kuwa operesheni kama hizi zinaweza kuathiri maisha ya raia wasio na hatia na kuibua hofu katika jamii za wahamiaji.

Hadi sasa, hakuna taarifa rasmi zilizotolewa kuhusu idadi ya watu waliokamatwa au walioripotiwa kujeruhiwa, lakini operesheni inaripotiwa kuendelea kwa miji mikubwa ya Minneapolis–St. Paul.

Waandishi wa habari na mashirika ya kiraia wanaendelea kufuatilia matukio haya kwa karibu huku jamii ikiendelea kuwa na tahadhari juu ya uwezekano wa kuongezeka kwa migongano kati ya raia na maafisa wa shirikisho.

Kwa ujumla, operesheni ya shirikisho Minnesota ni moja ya hatua kubwa ya utekaji na kukamata wahamiaji katika historia ya hivi karibuni, ikionyesha jinsi Marekani inavyolenga kudhibiti uhamiaji haramu na kuimarisha udhibiti wa sheria katika maeneo yenye mvutano mkubwa.

THE UNTOLD STORY OF THE KAMITI PRISON BREAK
How 3 terrorists embarrassed East Africa’s “most secure” prison.

On Mashujaa Day 2021, as President Uhuru Kenyatta announced the lifting of the night-to-dawn curfew, Kenyans celebrated freedom.

What nobody knew

That announcement didn’t just free citizens.
It completed an escape plan that had been cooking for months… behind the cold, unforgiving 10-foot walls of Kamiti Maximum Prison.

Deep inside Condemned Block A, Cell No. 6, three men were counting down their final hours as inmates.

The mission?
Escape Kamiti.

THE MEN BEHIND THE PLAN

Meet the masterminds:

-Musharaf Abdalla
-Juma Otieno (Yassin)
-Mohammed Ali Abikar

Certified Al-Shabaab operatives.
Hardened. Calculated. Desperate.

Musharaf and Yassin had been locked up since 2017 after attempting to storm Parliament Buildings in 2012—armed and ready. That stunt earned them 22 years at Kamiti Max.

Two years later, they were joined by Abikar, slapped with a massive 41-year sentence for communicating with the terrorists behind the Garissa University massacre that killed 147 students.

Later came Joseph Juma Odhiambo, arrested in Mandera while sneaking toward Somalia through an illegal border route. His reward? 15 years.

Different crimes. Same prison. Same bitterness.

“JUSTICE DELAYED…”

Despite courts proving their guilt beyond reasonable doubt, the four felt cheated.

Appeals dragged on.
Hope faded.
Anger brewed.

In their minds, justice delayed became justice denied.

So they agreed on one thing:
If the system wouldn’t free them, they’d free themselves.

ENTER: WARDEN X 

Step one? Compromise someone on the inside.

Using money Abikar could access from outside, they zeroed in on Warden X—the officer in charge of inmates doing routine maintenance.

Perfect target.

Why?

- He had access to tools
- He moved freely
- He knew duty rosters
- And he could pass information quietly

Soon, Warden X became their supply line, intelligence officer, and silent partner.

THE BLANKET TRICK 

Next move? A harmless complaint.

They wrote to prison welfare, claiming their cell was freezing cold.

Prison reforms kicked in.
Officials approved extra blankets.

Nobody suspected those blankets were about to become a rope ladder.

With Warden X’s help, tools started slipping into Cell No. 6:

- Chisel
- Blades
- Scissors
- Hooks
- Soap
- Reams of paper
- Brooms

Soap was used as glue.
Paper matched the wall’s colour perfectly.
The chisel drilled a hole.
Brooms measured wall height.
Blankets were cut, stitched, twisted.

Slowly. Quietly. Patiently.

By day: digging.
By night: tying ropes and praying.

THE FINAL TWO PROBLEMS

Problem one: curfew.
Covid rules meant night movement was impossible.

Solved on Mashujaa Day. Curfew lifted. 

Problem two: confidence.

That came a week later when fellow terror convict Egilva Bwire was released… and mysteriously disappeared immediately after freedom.

ATPU abduction rumors spread fast.

Message received loud and clear:
Even finishing your sentence doesn’t guarantee freedom.

That fear flipped the switch.

Escape was no longer optional.

D-DAY: NOVEMBER 15, 2021

After studying guard behaviour, broken CCTV cameras, and lazy shifts, they circled one date.

Why Nov 15?

- Less alert officers
- Some cameras not working
- A perfect security gap

A Toyota Probox was arranged.
Route planned: Kamiti - Machakos - Somalia.

At midnight, word came in:
Wardens on shift had passed by the canteen… and had a few drinks.

That was the green light.

THE ESCAPE 🏃🏽‍♂️

Minutes past midnight, they squeezed through the hole.

Out of the cell.
Past the main wall.
Toward staff quarters.

The blanket rope did its job.

They scaled walls, vanished into the dark, jumped into the waiting Probox—and disappeared.

By 3:30 a.m. they were in Machakos.

Kamiti had been beaten.

THE MOST KENYAN PLOT TWIST 🇰🇪

The second getaway car?

Never showed up.

Plan B?
Matatu.

Yes.
Three escaped terrorists.
Boarding public transport.

They headed toward Kitui… but fate had jokes.

A random citizen spotted them walking suspiciously and raised alarm.

Few kilometres later—boom. Arrested. 😭😂

BACK TO KAMITI… WITH QUESTIONS ❓

They were dragged back under heavy guard and charged with escape.

But during trial, things got weird.

They told the judge:

Warden X wasn’t among those charged
None of the tools used appeared as evidence

Just like that…
The man who made it possible?
Vanished from the story.

And that, my people, is how three terrorists briefly outsmarted East Africa’s toughest prison—only to be defeated by a missing car, a matatu, and one sharp-eyed Kenyan.

Kenya is not a real place.

The Arabic word firqa (فرقة) comes from faraq, which means to split, to separate, or to divide after being united. Linguistically, a sect refers to a group that breaks away from a united body. In Islam, a sect is a group that departs from the Qur’an and the authentic Sunnah upon the understanding of the Companions in belief, methodology, or core principles, while still claiming to belong to Islam. In other words, a sect is any group that separates from the Quran and Sunnah as understood by the Companions, whether by opposing them, introducing innovated beliefs or principles, making takfīr wrongly, denying established foundations of faith, or following desires and philosophy over revelation. This definition is critical because not every difference creates a sect. Differences in fiqh rulings, ijtihad, or minor issues do not constitute sectarianism, nor does following a fiqh imam. The recognized fiqh schools such as Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi, and Hanbali are not sects, and variations like the number of rakah or details of worship existed even among the Companions themselves.

🌟 What makes a group a sect: A group becomes a sect when it introduces deviation in fundamentals, such as:

❇️ Deviation in Aqidah

Examples:
 • Denying Allah’s attributes
 • Denying Qadar
 • Claiming Quran is created
 • Saying iman does not include actions

These are “Usul - The foundational beliefs and core principles of Islam that do not change, taken from the Quran, authentic Sunnah, and the understanding of the Companions”, or in simple words Usul is what you believe.

❇️ Deviation in “Manhaj - The method and way of understanding, practicing, and applying Islam, especially in dawah, dealing with differences, unity, and handling deviation” or is simple words Manhaj is how you follow and apply it.

Examples:
 • Making takfir of Muslims wrongly
 • Rebelling against rulers as a principle
 • Declaring the Ummah misguided except themselves
 • Using innovation as a method of dawah

Manhaj matters as much as belief.

❇️ Putting something above revelation. This is a major root cause. This is how sects are born.

Examples:
 • Reason over Quran and Sunnah
 • Philosophy over revelation
 • Political loyalty over truth
 • Blind following of personalities

❇️ Quran on sectarianism

Allah strongly condemns sects: “Indeed, those who divided their religion and became sects, you have nothing to do with them.”
(Qur’an 6:159)

“And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided.”
(Qur’an 3:103)

“And do not be like those who split and differed after clear proofs came to them.”
(Qur’an 3:105)

These verses show:
 • Unity is obligatory
 • Division after truth is blameworthy

❇️ Hadith on sects

The Prophet ﷺ said: “My Ummah will split into seventy-three sects. All of them are in the Fire except one.”

This does not praise sects. It is a warning, not a badge.

When asked who is saved, he ﷺ said: “Those who are upon what I and my Companions are upon.”

This shows:
 • Splitting is condemned
 • Truth is not based on numbers
 • Salvation is tied to following the way of the Prophet ﷺ and his Companions

💫 Important clarification: 
 • Hanafi, Maliki, Shafi‘i, Hanbali are NOT sects
 • They are fiqh methodologies within Ahl al-Sunnah
 • Sectarianism starts when belief and manhaj are corrupted

❇️ Sects did not appear randomly. They emerged due to:
 • Political fitnah
 • Ignorance of the Sunnah
 • Desire for leadership
 • Overreaction to other deviant groups
 • Mixing Islam with foreign ideas

Every sect began by leaving balance.

❇️ The saved group did not emerge later because Ahl al-Sunnah wal-Jamaah is simply Islam as it was revealed and practiced from the beginning. They did not form around a person, a movement, or a reaction to another group. They followed the Prophet ﷺ while he was alive, and after him they continued upon the understanding and practice of the Companions without adding or subtracting anything. When innovations appeared, they did not invent a new path in response; they rejected innovation and held firmly to what already existed. For this reason, Ahl al-Sunnah is not a sect among sects. They are the original path upon which the Ummah was united at the start. All sects came later by departing from this path, either in belief, methodology, or both. So the truth is not that Ahl al-Sunnah separated from others, but that others separated from Ahl al-Sunnah.

❇️ Ikhtilaf and Iftiraq are not the same, and confusing them causes major fitnah. Ikhtilaf means a legitimate difference in understanding or ijtihad (Making a sincere scholarly effort to derive a ruling from the Quran and authentic Sunnah when there is no clear explicit text, using correct knowledge and principles.) where the evidence allows more than one view. It existed among the Companions themselves, it does not break unity, and it does not touch the foundations of belief or manhaj. People may differ yet remain united upon the Sunnah. Iftiraq, on the other hand, means blameworthy division and splitting from the Jamaah after the truth is clear. It happens when people introduce innovation in Aqidah or manhaj, follow desires, make false principles, or give loyalty and enmity based on other than the Sunnah. Ikhtilaf does not create sects, but iftiraq does. Ikhtilaf is tolerated and sometimes unavoidable, while iftiraq is condemned and warned against in the Quran and Sunnah.

THE FITNA OF BLIND TAKFIR 

The Prophet ‎صلى الله عليه وعلى آله وصحبه وسلم said: “He who says to his brother 'O disbeliever', then it returns upon one of them."
[al-Muwatta, al-Bukhari, Muslim, at-Tirmidhi, Abu Dawud] 

He ‎صلى الله عليه وعلى آله وصحبه وسلم also said: “And he who accuses a believer of kufr (disbelief) then it is like killing him."
[Al-Bukhari]

Ibn Hajar says: “And what is correct is that the hadith (narration from the Prophet was said as a warning against a Muslim saying that to his brother. It is said, 'What returns upon him is his speaking ill of his brother and the sin of declaring him a kafir (disbeliever)', and this is reasonable. It is also said, 'It is to be feared that this will lead him into kufr', just as it is said, 'sins leads towards kufr'. Thus it is feared that if he continues in that and persists in it then he will have a bad end. I prefer from these sayings that it refers to the one who says it to someone from whom nothing is known except Islam and there is no justification or reason for him to claim that he is a kafir. So in such a case he becomes a kafir himself because of that, and this will be explained. So the meaning of the hadith is that his judgement of takfir (making someone a kafir) returns upon himself, so what is meant is takfir not kufr. So it is as if he passed judgement of kufr upon himself since he passed this judgement on one who is like him (i.e. a Muslim)."
[Imam ibn Hajar al-Asqalani ash-Shafi’i al-Ash’ari ‎رحمه الله in Fath al-Bari 10/466]

An-Nawawi said: "They differ as regards interpretation of this 'returning', so it is said, 'kufr returns upon him if he is making that lawful', and this is far from the context of the narration, and it is said, 'it is taken to refer to the Khawarij', since they declare believers to be kafirun (disbelievers)."
[Imam an-Nawawi ash-Shafi’i al-Ash’ari ‎رحمه الله in Sharh Sahih Muslim 2/50]

So where do a person stand who hasten to perform blind Takfir of the Muslims in relation to the saying of the Prophet ‎صلى الله عليه وعلى آله وصحبه وسلم: “Abusing a Muslim is open sin and killing him is kufr." 
[Agreed upon] 

And in another Hadith: “The Muslim is the Brother of a Muslim, he does not oppress or forsake him." 
[Muslim] 

Also in relation to his saying:
“All of the Muslim to the Muslim is inviolable; his blood, his wealth and his honour." 
[Muslim, Abu Dawud, At-Tirmidhi]

Al-Qurtubi says in his tafsir of Surah al-Hujurat:
" ' ... and His (Allah) saying: 'lest your deeds go to waste whilst you are unaware.' [al-Quran 49:2] does not mean that a person becomes a kafir without knowing since just as a person does not become a believer except through choosing iman (faith) over kufr, then likewise a believer does not become a kafir without intending kufr and choosing it, and there is consensus (ijma') regarding this."
[Imam al-Qurtubi al-Maliki al-Ash’ari ‎رحمه الله in Tafsir Jami 'li Ahkam al-Qur'an 7/6128]

Sayyiduna Imam Malik ibn Anas رضي الله عنه said: “If a man were upon ninety-nine acts of unbelief and one act of faith, I would ascribe him to that one act of goodness as good assumption for a Muslim.”
[Imam al-Laalikaa’I ash-Shafi’i رحمه الله in Sharh Usool I’tiqaad Ahlus Sunnah Wa'l Jama’ah 5/27]

Imam Ahmad Rida al-Hanafi al-Maturidi al-Qadri ‎رحمه الله said: “There is surely much difference between accepting words of Kufr and declaring a person a Kaafir. We must be extremely careful in that. We should remain silent. If we find the minutest possibility that the person is still a Muslim, we should fear branding that person a Kaafir”. 
[Sall us-Suyoof al-Hindiya]

The fall of Kismayo:
On October 16, 2011, Kenya made a historic decision. Under Operation Linda Nchi, the Kenya Defence Forces (KDF) crossed into Somalia in pursuit of the Al-Shabaab militant group, which had carried out attacks on Kenyan soil. The operation was authorized by President Mwai Kibaki, Kenya’s Commander-in-Chief, and overseen by General Julius Karangi, who was then the Chief of the Defence Forces.

For nearly a year, KDF advanced steadily through southern Somalia, securing key towns such as Afmadow and weakening Al-Shabaab’s grip on the Lower Juba region. The ultimate objective was clear: Kismayo, a strategic port city that served as Al-Shabaab’s main source of revenue and supply.
By September 2012, preparations for the final assault were complete. The operation, known as Operation Sledge Hammer, marked a turning point in Kenya’s military history. It was the country’s first major amphibious operation, involving a coordinated attack from the sea, land, and air.

In the early hours of September 28, 2012, Kenyan Navy vessels approached Kismayo from the Indian Ocean while Kenya Air Force aircraft provided air support. At the same time, KDF ground forces advanced toward the city alongside the Somali National Army and AMISOM troops. The overall mission fell under AMISOM, which was commanded at the time by Lieutenant General Andrew Gutti of Uganda. Kenyan forces in the sector were led by Major General Eric Mwathi, while naval operations were coordinated by Rear Admiral Thomas Muthungu, the then Commander of the Kenya Navy.

Faced with a well-coordinated, three-pronged advance, Al-Shabaab fighters withdrew from the city rather than engage in a direct confrontation. By the morning of September 28, 2012, allied forces had entered Kismayo and secured the port with minimal resistance.

The capture of Kismayo dealt a severe blow to Al-Shabaab. The group lost its most important economic lifeline, significantly weakening its operational capacity. For the people of Kismayo, the fall of the city marked the beginning of relief from years of fear and instability.

Kismayo did not fall through chaos or disorder.
It fell through discipline, planning, and command.
On that quiet September morning in 2012, history changed along the Somali coast, and Kenya firmly etched its name into the story of regional security.

Four Al-Shabaab attackers stormed the university, moving with deadly purpose. Their footsteps were heavy, their intent cruel. Panic spread faster than sound. Doors slammed. Screams filled corridors. Young men and women ran blindly, driven by one instinct: to live.

Some students jumped from windows. Others hid in wardrobes, under beds, behind classroom doors holding their breath, hoping silence would save them. In the chaos, courage appeared in small, heartbreaking ways. Friends pulled each other to safety. Some warned others to run, even when escape meant leaving themselves behind.
The attackers separated students by religion, a cruel test that turned faith into a weapon. Many lives were lost,not because they fought back, but because they stood for nothing more than being students, being Kenyan, being human.

For 15 long hours, fear ruled the campus.
Outside, families watched helplessly as news spread. Parents called phones that would never ring again. Kenya held its breath. The nation mourned even before the siege ended.
When Kenyan security forces finally regained control, the sun set on a broken campus. 148 lives mostly young students,were gone. Dreams of graduation, careers, love, and family were buried in a single day.

Garissa University was left scarred, but not erased.
The attack shook Kenya to its core. It exposed pain, anger, and deep questions but it also revealed unity. Blood donors flooded hospitals. Strangers prayed together. A nation wept as one.
And though Al-Shabaab intended terror, what remains stronger is memory.

The memory of students who woke up to chase knowledge and never came home.
The memory of a country reminded that education, hope, and youth are powerful and therefore feared by extremists.

Garissa did not die that day.
It became a symbol of loss, resilience, and the price of peace.

MOSQUE CHAIRMAN SPEECH FOR THE EVENT TO MARK THE
COMPLETION OF MAQAM HABIB NOH REJUVENATION WORKS ON
SUNDAY, 11 JANUARY 2026

Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm

All praise is to Allah SWT, the creator of the universe.

May blessings and peace be upon the noblest of Prophets and Messengers, NABI Muḥammad SAW, and upon his family and all his Companions.

Acting Minister-in-Charge of Muslim Affairs,
Associate Professor Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim,

Member of Parliament for Jalan Besar GRC,
Dr. Wan Rizal,

President of MUIS,
Mr Mohd Saat Bin Abdul Rahman,

Chief Executive of MUIS,
Mr Kadir Maideen,

Deputy Mufti,
Ustaz Dr Izal Mustafa Kamar,

Senior Director of One Mosque Sector,
Mr Zalman Ali,

District Superintendent of Mosques for District South,
Mr Izuan Mohd Rais,

Distinguished guests,
Ladies and gentlemen, brothers and sisters in Islam.

Assalāmu‘alaikum warahmatullāhi wabarakātuh.

1. Opening Remarks & Gratitude
Today, with hearts filled with gratitude and relief, we gather to witness the official reopening of Maqam Habib Noh Al-Habsyi — one of Singapore’s most cherished Islamic heritage landmarks. The last major renovation of this Maqam began in 1986 and was completed around 1987.

We are deeply honoured by the presence of all who have joined us on this blessed occasion, especially Associate Professor Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim and Dr Wan Rizal MP for Jalan Besar GRC, which Palmer Road fall under it's jurisdiction, for making time in their demanding schedule to grace this very significant event.

2. Closure & Renovation Timeline
As many of you are aware, the Maqam was officially closed for renovation and upgrading works on 18 June 2024.
The primary challenge lay in the construction of the dome. We brought in expertise from overseas to ensure the dome is constructed in honour of his legacy.

Nevertheless, there are still some finishing works within the interior of the Maqam that require careful attention. As the caretakers of this sacred site, we are committed to ensuring that every aspect was completed meticulously and safely, for the comfort of all visitors.

Alhamdulillah, after much resilience and perseverance, we were able to open to visitors of the Maqam from 19 November 2025.

3. Cost & Accountability
The total cost of the works stands at about $2 million.

4. Words of Appreciation
On behalf of the Mosque Management Board of Haji Muhammad Salleh, I would like to express our deepest appreciation to:

Our generous sponsors and donors who made this renovation possible, particularly those who contributed significantly towards the works and are present with us today;

The Mosque family, project team, MUIS, Warees, contractors, and workers who continued tirelessly despite technical challenges, and the wider community, for their patience, prayers, and understanding throughout this period.

5. A Spiritual Reflection - 𝐇𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐍𝐨𝐭𝐞 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐦 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐫𝐜𝐚𝐬𝐞
Many may not know that the historic staircase leading up to Maqam Habib Noh carries with it more than a century of history. Our research indicates that it was designed by the distinguished British architectural firm Swan & Maclaren in 1894, approved by the then Council under British rule, and built between 1895 and 1896.
As part of the current refurbishment works at the Maqam, this significant heritage feature has been carefully preserved. The original landing remains intact — only cleaned and structurally checked — 𝗲𝗻𝘀𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝘃𝗶𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀 𝘁𝗼𝗱𝗮𝘆 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗻𝘂𝗲 𝘁𝗼 𝘄𝗮𝗹𝗸 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘀𝗮𝗺𝗲 𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗽𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘃𝗲𝗱 𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗺𝗼𝗿𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝟭𝟮𝟱 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀.

This staircase is more than a passageway; it is part of the Maqam’s very face, 𝗮 𝘀𝗶𝗹𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗵𝗮𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲. It has never been moved nor altered, standing steadfast in its place, bearing silent testimony to the unfolding history of the area while welcoming each step taken with prayer and remembrance for its visitors.

The Maqam of Habib Noh is more than concrete, metals, and timber. It is one of the places that draws hearts closer to Allah — a place where we remember the legacy of a pious soul, a saint of Allah, Habib Noh Bin Muhammad Al-Habsyi: his piety, his love for Allah and the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, and his service to humanity.

Our efforts to renew this place are not merely about preserving a building, but about keeping alive the memory of a righteous soul who devoted his entire life to Allah. May all who visit be inspired by his humility, sincerity, and compassion for the ummah, and strive to emulate these noble qualities.

For more than a century, this Maqam has truly embodied what we proudly call our official tagline: “Spiritual Oasis in the City.”

This phrase was inspired by the meaningful words of the former Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs, Dr Ahmad Mattar (who is here today with us), in the commemorative magazine published for the reopening of the mosque and Maqam in 1987, where he described this place as “a serene and peaceful sanctuary — like an oasis that provides the water of life.”

Inspired by these words, a former Mosque Secretary proposed that the phrase “Spiritual Oasis in the City” be adopted as our official tagline, as a clear expression of our mission: to be a sanctuary of the soul — a space of calm, renewed faith, and remembrance of Allah — amid the hustle and bustle of city life.

Over time, this phrase faded from use and was set aside for a significant period before efforts were made to revive and preserve it once again.

The beauty and depth of this phrase continue to guide, inspire, and anchor us to this very day.

6. Book Documentation Project
In addition to the physical works to honour the memory of Habib Noh Al-Habsyi, we also embarked, two years ago, on a research and documentation project.

This project examines the history of Habib Noh, Habib Abdul Rahman, Haji Muhammad Salleh, the Maqam, the mosque, and the surrounding area. 

Three respected academic scholars and researchers were appointed, and they have produced many valuable findings and insights.

InsyaAllah, these findings will be compiled into a book and published within this year.

7. Personal Reflection
Before concluding, allow me to share a personal reflection. I have served at this mosque and Maqam for more than three decades. During this time, I have witnessed the Maqam of Habib Noh Al-Habsyi not only being visited, but becoming known to visitors from all over the world.

They come from diverse backgrounds, including foreigners and people of different faiths, drawn by the story and example of Habib Noh, who exemplified honour, respect, and unity among humanity, values deeply upheld by our religion.

The care, maintenance, and safety of this Maqam — established over a century ago — have always been a personal priority for me, from my days as a volunteer activist, to a board member, and now as Chairman.

8. Closing & Supplication
On this occasion of the official reopening of the Maqam of Habib Noh, we pray that Allah accepts our efforts, blesses our donors, and allows this place to continue being a source of light, serenity, and barakah for the community — a true Spiritual Oasis in the City..... indeed

May Allah grant us steadfastness in preserving our heritage, strengthening unity among communities, and serving Islam in Singapore.

Wa Billāhit-Tawfīq wal-Hidāyah,
Wassalāmu‘alaikum warahmatullāhi wabarakātuh.
